item.title: [New] Intune ends CNAME auto-discovery for Windows MDM-only enrollment on 15 January 2027
item.description:
A stale EnterpriseEnrollment CNAME that nobody owns is a record an attacker could point elsewhere; once discovery stops using it, it can be removed.

Intune · Find out whether any Windows MDM-only enrollment still relies on the CNAME, update the enrollment instructions before January, and remove the EnterpriseEnrollment record once nothing uses it.

item.title: [Message Center] MC1509780 Intune ending support for Windows MDM-only enrollment CNAME auto-discovery
item.description:
Starting January 15, 2027, Intune will end support for DNS CNAME auto-discovery in Windows MDM-only enrollment. Organizations using this must have users manually enter the Microsoft enrollment server URL. Existing devices and other enrollment methods remain unaffected. Update enrollment procedures accordingly.

Microsoft Intune · planForChange · act by 2027-01-15
